title: licaria pachycarpa
intro: Licaria pachycarpa, commonly known as the Yellow Copal tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lauraceae. The health benefits of Licaria pachycarpa include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Licaria pachycarpa include its use as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, as well as its ability to act as an antiseptic, promoting wound healing and preventing infection. The bioactive constituents of Licaria pachycarpa include volatile oils, which contain compounds such as limonene and caryophyllene, that are responsible for its medicinal properties.
